hypothesis: A small additive tree correction to the fitted liquidation pair may preserve its useful level and slopes while capturing remaining nonlinear context.
selection_exposure: Initial 16-fit results were inspected. This is an adaptive development experiment.
training_target: Magnitude minus same-fold training-fitted pair forecast. Pair control reused without additional fitting; residual labels never use validation outcomes.
prediction: max(0, same-fold pair prediction + residual XGBoost prediction)
budget_change: Reallocate the 3 final-refit slots and 1 failure reserve to 4 development fits, consistent with user deferring fresh test work. No final model refit in this budget.
stopping_rule: Run these four fits only, report results including failure; no further model search within this budget.
